title: Microsoft Forms: Copilot in Forms for US Government clouds
summary: Hold: the statement that no prerequisites are documented overlooks Microsoft's published Copilot identity and service requirements. Narrow that statement to government-cloud-specific prerequisites. The roadmap facts match the record; the default, feature-by-feature government licensing and separate Forms Copilot switch remain undocumented.

claims.claim: Any prerequisites for Copilot in Forms are not yet documented.
claims.quote:
Requirements vary based on the Copilot experience and Microsoft 365 app that your users access.
